Welcome to Cluster-SSG ⚡

Cluster-SSG is a next-generation Static Site Generator written in 100% Pure Cluster Language with zero external dependencies.

It unifies the three best concepts from modern web engineering:

  • Jekyll Conventions: Clean directories, intuitive frontmatter headers, and layout inheritance.
  • Hugo Speed: Single-pass compiler generating over 25,000 pages per second natively via LLVM.
  • Astro Islands Architecture: Zero JavaScript overhead by default, with selective client hydration only where interactivity is required.

Interactive Island Component Demo

Below is an interactive Astro-style component island rendered directly from .cld using client:load:

[Interactive Island: Counter]

Notice that the rest of this page contains 0 bytes of JavaScript. Only the isolated Counter island hydrates on the client!

Native .cld Document & Binary Wire Security

Cluster-SSG replaces slow, unparsed Markdown and JSON with native .cld (Cluster Document) and .clb (Cluster Binary Bundle) formats.

Default Page Code Security:
When running with --binary, Cluster-SSG streams pre-compiled binary bytecode bundles over the wire. Web scrapers and bots cannot read your templates or source code—pages are safely decoded directly in the browser!
